fields.body_md:
## At a glance

Coventry University teaches its master's courses in Coventry, England. This page covers three one-year courses in computing, data and business. The most important thing to know is the first-year cost. Tuition for MSc Computer Science is **£19,980** for 2027-28. With visa money and visa fees added, the first-year total for that course is **£31,853**.

The English test you need is IELTS (International English Language Testing System).

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Campus | Priory Street, Coventry CV1 5FB |
| Course length | **1 year** full-time (up to 2 years with a professional placement) |
| Tuition, MSc Computer Science (2027-28) | **£19,980** a year |
| English test | IELTS **6.5** overall, with no part below **5.5** |

## What it really costs

Tuition is charged per year. For 2027-28 entry, the course pages show:

- MSc Computer Science: **£19,980** a year
- MSc Data Science and Computational Intelligence: **£19,980** a year
- MBA: **£21,825** a year

All three are one-year full-time courses. The course pages say their information is for 2026-27 entry and is guidance for 2027-28 entry. The fees above are the 2027-28 figures shown on each course page. Check the fee on the course page before you apply.

The UK student visa also asks you to show money for living costs. If you study outside London, you must show **£1,171 for each month** of your course, up to **9 months**. You must have had this money for 28 days in a row. The last day of that 28-day period must be within 31 days of the day you apply. This is proof of money. It is not a fee.

Two more visa payments apply. The visa application fee is **£558** when you apply from outside the UK. The Immigration Health Surcharge, a charge for students, is **£776 for each year of your visa**. You also need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies). This is the document your course provider gives you for your visa application.

For one year of MSc Computer Science, the sum looks like this:

| Item | Calculation | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition, 2027-28 | One year of the course fee | £19,980 |
| Living money for the visa | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Visa application fee | Fee from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 for 1 year (minimum) | £776 or more |
| **First-year total** | £19,980 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 | **at least £31,853** |

Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164.

The £10,539 is proof of money, not a fee. This total is an example for one year of one course, not a full budget. It does not include flights or travel to the UK.

For the visa rules, read our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare costs across UK universities, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Ways to reduce the cost

**Coventry University Group Scholarship.** This gives **£2,000 a year** of study off tuition. It is for self-funded international students who are not from the EU, on full-time taught degrees. It applies to 2026/27 or 2027/28 entry. You do not need to apply. You must be fully enrolled for the 2026/27 or 2027/28 academic year. Online courses are excluded.

For a one-year course where you qualify, tuition becomes **£17,980** (£19,980 − £2,000).

**Alumni discount.** If you already studied at Coventry University, you can get **25% off** postgraduate courses for start dates across 2026-27. This is for Coventry graduates only, not for students in general.

## Getting in

Each course has its own entry rules. Check the course page before you apply.

- **MSc Computer Science:** an honours degree at 2:2 or above, or an international equivalent, in a computational discipline.
- **MBA:** a 2:2 or above in any discipline, or an international equivalent, and at least three years of relevant work experience after your degree.

For Indian degrees, Coventry's international entry page asks for **60%** in a three-year undergraduate degree and **55%** in a four-year degree. It also names some Indian universities that accept **55%** for a three-year degree. Check that list before you apply.

The English test is IELTS. Coventry asks for **IELTS 6.5** overall for all three courses, with no part below **5.5**.

## Deadlines

Deadlines for the January 2027 intake:

| Intake | Final application deadline | Deadline to meet offer conditions | Enrolment deadline |
|---|---|---|---|
| January 2027 | 1 December 2026 | 4 December 2026 | 1 February 2027 |

Courses start in September 2027, November 2027, January 2028, March 2028, May 2028 and July 2028. The international deadline table does not list a September 2027 intake. Check the table on the [international apply page](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/international-students-hub/apply/) for that date.

**Tuition deposit.** A tuition deposit is an advance payment to the university. Coventry requires it before it releases your CAS, and the due date is in your offer letter. Students from Punjab, Uttarakhand and Haryana must pay their full first-year tuition. If you are from another Indian state, check the deposit rules on the international apply page before you accept an offer.

**Apply early.** You can apply for the visa up to 6 months before your course starts. Gov.uk says a visa decision usually takes 3 weeks from outside the UK.

## Courses to look at

This page covers three master's courses in detail:

- [MSc Computer Science](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/course-structure/pg/ees/computer-science-msc/?term=2027-28): one year full-time. A version with a professional placement can take up to two years, with a **£1,950** professional placement fee.
- [MSc Data Science and Computational Intelligence](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/course-structure/pg/ees/data-science-and-computational-intelligence-msc/?term=2027-28): one year full-time, with the same IELTS rule as the other two courses.
- [MBA](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/course-structure/pg/cbl/masters-in-business-administration/?term=2027-28): one year full-time, for graduates with work experience.

## Where you'll live

The course pages list the location as Coventry University (Coventry), at Priory Street. You can apply for student accommodation online.

The 2026-27 postgraduate rates are charged over 50 weeks. For example, a deluxe studio at Bishop Gate and Godiva Place costs **£232** a week, or **£11,600** for the year. These are 2026-27 rates. The fees page also lists lower rates for other rooms. Check the [accommodation fees page](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/life-on-campus/accommodation/applying/accommodation-fees/) for the room and year you need.

## Who it's a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- You have a computing degree at 2:2 or above, and you want a one-year master's in computer science.
- You can reach IELTS 6.5, with no part below 5.5.
- You have at least three years of work experience and want an MBA.
- You qualify for the £2,000 Group Scholarship, which brings tuition to £17,980 for a one-year course.

**Think carefully if:**

- Your degree is not in a computational discipline. The computer science course asks for one.
- Your score is close to the minimum for a three-year degree, which is 55% or 60%. Check the entry page before you apply.
- Your savings or family support will not cover the first-year total of £31,853 for MSc Computer Science.

faq_json.q: How much is tuition for MSc Computer Science at Coventry for international students?
faq_json.a: The course page shows £19,980 a year for 2027-28 entry. The course is one year full-time.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need for Coventry University?
faq_json.a: You need IELTS 6.5 overall, with no part below 5.5. This applies to MSc Computer Science, MSc Data Science and Computational Intelligence, and the MBA.

faq_json.q: What is the first-year cost of MSc Computer Science at Coventry?
faq_json.a: Our example adds £19,980 tuition, £10,539 living money (£1,171 a month for 9 months), the £558 visa fee and the £776 health surcharge for one year. The total is at least £31,853, because the surcharge is £776 for each year of your visa. It is an example, not a full budget.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship at Coventry for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Coventry's Group Scholarship is for self-funded international students, which includes Indian students. It gives £2,000 a year off tuition on full-time taught degrees, and you do not need to apply.

faq_json.q: What is the application deadline for Coventry's January 2027 intake?
faq_json.a: The final application deadline is 1 December 2026, and the enrolment deadline is 1 February 2027. For September 2027 dates, check the international apply page.

faq_json.q: Do I need a computing degree for MSc Computer Science at Coventry?
faq_json.a: Yes. The course asks for an honours degree at 2:2 or above, or an international equivalent, in a computational discipline.
